oracle_robustness.median_interval_note: Order-statistic interval and exact sign test refer to median/sign probability; finite-n percentile bootstrap interval is approximate and may disagree. Do not select the more favorable interval.
oracle_robustness.caution: Exploratory sensitivity; different tests target different location/symmetry nulls, no significance selection. Original Holm family retained.

design_sensitivity.interpretation: Design sensitivity of paired t test; conservative first Holm threshold when adjusted. Not achieved power, exact signflip power or evidence that nonsignificance is caused by small n.
